changelog: Intent-named entry for the existing Scavio skill
display_name: Meta Ad Library API - Facebook and Instagram Ad Search
summary: Meta Ad Library search by keyword, Facebook Page id or ad archive id, returning the full ad creative, run dates, the Meta platforms each ad ran on, and spend, reach and impressions on political and issue ads. Cursor pagination walks every ad, not just page one. 3 endpoints, 1 credit per page, structured JSON.
